question: Who is the first Indian boxer to win a gold medal at the World Boxing Cup 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hitesh Gulia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Hitesh Gulia** became the first Indian boxer to win a gold medal at the World Boxing Cup 2025.
 
• He achieved this historic milestone in the **75 kg middleweight category**.
 
• The World Boxing Cup 2025 was held in **Belgrade, Serbia**, showcasing elite boxing talents from around the globe.
 
• Hitesh defeated **Sergey Ivanov of Russia** in the final match with a unanimous decision from the judges.
 
• This victory marked a significant achievement for Indian boxing on the international stage, reinforcing India’s growing prominence in the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Boxing Cup**

 
 
• It is an international boxing competition organized by the International Boxing Association (**IBA**).
 
• The tournament features top boxers from various countries competing across different weight categories.
 
• It serves as a platform for nations to showcase their boxing talent and gain international exposure.
 
 
 
• **Indian Boxing Achievements**
 
 
• India has a rich history in boxing, with notable achievements in the Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games.
 
• Prominent Indian boxers include **Mary Kom**, **Vijender Singh**, and **Lovelina Borgohain**.
 
• Hitesh Gulia’s win adds to India’s growing legacy in international boxing events.
 
 
 
• **International Boxing Association (IBA)**
 
 
• The IBA is the world governing body for amateur boxing, formerly known as AIBA.
 
• It was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in **Lausanne, Switzerland**.
 
• The IBA is responsible for organizing major boxing events and maintaining rules and standards for the sport.
 
 
 
• **Training and Preparation**
 
 
• Indian boxers undergo rigorous training at facilities like the **National Boxing Academy** in Haryana and other Sports Authority of India (SAI) centers.
 
• Coaching and support from experienced trainers, alongside exposure to international competitions, play a crucial role in their success.
